comment: The proposed REDDHI markers remain mostly binary, such as whether registries exist or data is exchanged. They do not adequately assess coverage, quality, use, resilience, governance, or institutional sustainability.

anchor.note: p.27 l.Lines 124-129 read as the printed page; section 2.2.1 agrees

public.text: The proposed REDDHI markers remain mostly binary, such as whether registries exist or data is exchanged. They do not adequately assess coverage, quality, use, resilience, governance, or institutional sustainability.
public.suggestedRevision: Define measurable indicators for each marker, including population coverage, programme reuse, API availability, conformance, data completeness, update latency, uptime, recovery capability, governance maturity, domestic financing, and user adoption.
